title: Yummy Cookie
description: A project to launch a profitable cookie store offering fresh, high-quality cookies with unique flavors and excellent customer service.

content.title: Project Goal
content.information: Launch a profitable cookie store offering fresh, high-quality cookies with unique flavors and excellent customer service.

content.title: Timeline
content.information: 8‑week schedule covering planning, legal permits, location setup, menu development, branding, hiring, soft launch, and grand opening.

content.title: Key Tasks
content.information: Planning, legal registration, equipment purchase, recipe finalization, marketing creation, staff hiring and training, and launch preparations.

content.title: Risks & Mitigations
content.information: Permit delays mitigated by early application; supplier issues mitigated by backup vendors; low traffic mitigated by free cookie promotion.

content.title: Success Metrics
content.information: First month revenue of $5,000+, 4.5+ star rating, and 20% repeat customer rate by month two.
